description: Land Acquisition - Rambuk Oluwa, Laggala Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land are needed for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land matters (acquisition of property) without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or electoral matters.
